\par\smallskip\parbox{\textwidth}{\scriptsize All arms use the same student, recipe, data pipeline and, for the distillation arms, the same losses ($\lambda_{\mathrm{chg}}=8$, $\lambda_{\mathrm{sem}}=1$, $T_{\mathrm{s}}=2$, all pixels) and the same eight-view cache format; only the source of the targets changes. Self-distillation: the teacher is the undistilled student of seed 1 (best test epoch on SECOND, best validation epoch on each fold); its students use other seeds. Ground truth only: change target = ground truth average-pooled to the cache resolution and upsampled; semantic target = label smoothing with $\varepsilon$ matched to the teacher's mean confidence in the true class (0.21--0.28 across folds), uniform on unlabeled pixels. $\Delta$: arm $-$ no KD (constant LR), paired by seed (SECOND) or by fold and seed (Landsat-SCD); on SECOND, DistilSCD $-$ no KD is paired over the five common seeds (unpaired over all seeds: Table~\ref{tab:second}).}
